		};

            value === true ||
            value === 'accepted' ||

        return isGrantedValue(cookieState.optionalCookies.functional);

        root.hidden = !isVisible;
    }

    function syncFallbackVisibility() {
        setFallbackVisible(!hasFunctionalConsent());
    }

        modal.hidden = false;
        backdrop.hidden = false;
        status.textContent = '';
        acceptButton.focus();
    }

    function closeModal() {
        modal.hidden = true;
        backdrop.hidden = true;

<script>
(function () {
    'use strict';

    var COOKIE_CONTROL_COOKIE = 'CookieControl';

    // Current GTM/Civic optionalCookies order:
    // 0 = analytics
    // 1 = functional
    // 2 = targeting
    var ANALYTICS_CATEGORY_INDEX = 0;
    var FUNCTIONAL_CATEGORY_INDEX = 1;

    var root = document.getElementById('im-qualified-consent-fallback');
    var launcher = document.getElementById('im-qcf-launcher');
    var modal = document.getElementById('im-qcf-modal');
    var backdrop = document.getElementById('im-qcf-backdrop');
    var acceptButton = document.getElementById('im-qcf-accept');
    var closeButton = document.getElementById('im-qcf-close');
    var status = document.getElementById('im-qcf-status');

    if (!root || !launcher || !modal || !backdrop || !acceptButton || !closeButton) {
        return;
    }

    function getCookie(name) {
        var cookies = document.cookie ? document.cookie.split(';') : [];
        var prefix = name + '=';

        for (var i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
            var cookie = cookies[i].trim();

            if (cookie.indexOf(prefix) === 0) {
                return cookie.substring(prefix.length);
            }
        }

        return '';
    }

    function parseCookieControlCookie() {
        var raw = getCookie(COOKIE_CONTROL_COOKIE);

        if (!raw) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            return JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(raw));
        } catch (decodeError) {
            try {
                return JSON.parse(raw);
            } catch (parseError) {
                return null;
            }
        }
    }

    function isGrantedValue(value) {
        return (
            value === true ||
            value === 'accepted' ||
            value === 'granted' ||
            value === 'on'
        );
    }

    function hasFunctionalConsent() {
        var cookieState = parseCookieControlCookie();

        if (!cookieState || !cookieState.optionalCookies) {
            return false;
        }

        return isGrantedValue(cookieState.optionalCookies.functional);
    }

    function setFallbackVisible(isVisible) {
        root.hidden = !isVisible;
    }

    function syncFallbackVisibility() {
        setFallbackVisible(!hasFunctionalConsent());
    }

    function openModal() {
        modal.hidden = false;
        backdrop.hidden = false;
        status.textContent = '';
        acceptButton.focus();
    }

    function closeModal() {
        modal.hidden = true;
        backdrop.hidden = true;
        status.textContent = '';
        launcher.focus();
    }

    function acceptCookiesAndChat() {
        if (
            !window.CookieControl ||
            typeof window.CookieControl.changeCategory !== 'function'
        ) {
            status.textContent = 'Cookie preferences are still loading. Please try again in a moment.';
            return;
        }

        try {

            window.CookieControl.changeCategory(ANALYTICS_CATEGORY_INDEX, true);
            window.CookieControl.changeCategory(FUNCTIONAL_CATEGORY_INDEX, true);

            closeModal();
            setFallbackVisible(false);

            // Re-check after Civic/GTM have had time to update the CookieControl cookie and dataLayer.

<script>
jQuery(document).ready(function() {
  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]');
  const tabLists = document.querySelectorAll('[role="tablist"]');

  if (!tabs.length || !tabLists.length) return;

  tabs.forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', changeTabs);
  });

  tabLists.forEach(tabList => {
    const listTabs = tabList.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]');
    let tabFocus = 0;

    tabList.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (e.keyCode === 38 || e.keyCode === 40) {
        listTabs[tabFocus].setAttribute('tabindex', -1);

        if (e.keyCode === 40) {
          tabFocus = (tabFocus + 1) % listTabs.length;
        } else {
          tabFocus = (tabFocus - 1 + listTabs.length) % listTabs.length;
        }

        listTabs[tabFocus].setAttribute('tabindex', 0);
        listTabs[tabFocus].focus();
      }
    });
  });
});
function changeTabs(e) {
  const target = e.target.closest('[role="tab"]');
  if (!target) return;

  const root = target.closest('.hp-product-video') || document;
  const tabParent = target.parentNode;

  stopVideos();

  tabParent
    .querySelectorAll('[aria-selected="true"]')
    .forEach(t => t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'));

  tabParent
    .querySelectorAll('.active')
    .forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));

  target.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
  target.classList.add('active');

  const videoRoot = target.closest('.hp-product-video') || document;
  const bg = videoRoot.querySelector('.video-preview-bg');
  if (bg) {
    bg.classList.remove('teams','archiving','cloud','ep');
    if (target.classList.contains('teams')) bg.classList.add('teams');
    if (target.classList.contains('archiving')) bg.classList.add('archiving');
    if (target.classList.contains('cloud')) bg.classList.add('cloud');
    if (target.classList.contains('ep')) bg.classList.add('ep');
  }

  tabParent.querySelectorAll('.no-divider').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('no-divider'));

  const prev = target.previousElementSibling;
  if (prev && prev.matches('.video-item')) {
    prev.classList.add('no-divider');
  }

  root
    .querySelectorAll('[role="tabpanel"]')
    .forEach(p => p.setAttribute('hidden', 'true'));

  const id = target.getAttribute('aria-controls');
  if (!id) return;

  const panel = root.querySelector('#' + id);
  if (panel) panel.removeAttribute('hidden');
}
function stopVideos() {
  var videos = document.querySelectorAll('iframe.vimeo-vid');
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(videos, function(video) {
    try {
      var player = new Vimeo.Player(video);
      player.pause();
    } catch (e) {}
  });
}

function homepageFancy() {	
  if (typeof jQuery != 'undefined' && typeof jQuery.fancybox != 'undefined') {
    jQuery('.fancybox-media').fancybox({

      closeEffect: 'fade',
      helpers: { media: {} },
      beforeLoad: function() {
        jQuery("#form-header").text(jQuery(this.element).data("fb-title"));
      }
    });
  } else {
    window.setTimeout(homepageFancy, 50);
  }
}

homepageFancy();

<script>
(function () {
    'use strict';

    var COOKIE_CONTROL_COOKIE = 'CookieControl';

    // Current GTM/Civic optionalCookies order:
    // 0 = analytics
    // 1 = functional
    // 2 = targeting
    var ANALYTICS_CATEGORY_INDEX = 0;
    var FUNCTIONAL_CATEGORY_INDEX = 1;

    var root = document.getElementById('im-qualified-consent-fallback');
    var launcher = document.getElementById('im-qcf-launcher');
    var modal = document.getElementById('im-qcf-modal');
    var backdrop = document.getElementById('im-qcf-backdrop');
    var acceptButton = document.getElementById('im-qcf-accept');
    var closeButton = document.getElementById('im-qcf-close');
    var status = document.getElementById('im-qcf-status');

    if (!root || !launcher || !modal || !backdrop || !acceptButton || !closeButton) {
        return;
    }

    function getCookie(name) {
        var cookies = document.cookie ? document.cookie.split(';') : [];
        var prefix = name + '=';

        for (var i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
            var cookie = cookies[i].trim();

            if (cookie.indexOf(prefix) === 0) {
                return cookie.substring(prefix.length);
            }
        }

        return '';
    }

    function parseCookieControlCookie() {
        var raw = getCookie(COOKIE_CONTROL_COOKIE);

        if (!raw) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            return JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(raw));
        } catch (decodeError) {
            try {
                return JSON.parse(raw);
            } catch (parseError) {
                return null;
            }
        }
    }

    function isGrantedValue(value) {
        return (
            value === true ||
            value === 'accepted' ||
            value === 'granted' ||
            value === 'on'
        );
    }

    function hasFunctionalConsent() {
        var cookieState = parseCookieControlCookie();

        if (!cookieState || !cookieState.optionalCookies) {
            return false;
        }

        return isGrantedValue(cookieState.optionalCookies.functional);
    }

    function setFallbackVisible(isVisible) {
        root.hidden = !isVisible;
    }

    function syncFallbackVisibility() {
        setFallbackVisible(!hasFunctionalConsent());
    }

    function openModal() {
        modal.hidden = false;
        backdrop.hidden = false;
        status.textContent = '';
        acceptButton.focus();
    }

    function closeModal() {
        modal.hidden = true;
        backdrop.hidden = true;
        status.textContent = '';
        launcher.focus();
    }

    function acceptCookiesAndChat() {
        if (
            !window.CookieControl ||
            typeof window.CookieControl.changeCategory !== 'function'
        ) {
            status.textContent = 'Cookie preferences are still loading. Please try again in a moment.';
            return;
        }

        try {
            // Fire Civic callbacks for analytics and functional consent.
            window.CookieControl.changeCategory(ANALYTICS_CATEGORY_INDEX, true);
            window.CookieControl.changeCategory(FUNCTIONAL_CATEGORY_INDEX, true);

            closeModal();
            setFallbackVisible(false);

            // Re-check after Civic/GTM have had time to update the CookieControl cookie and dataLayer.
            window.setTimeout(syncFallbackVisibility, 250);
            window.setTimeout(syncFallbackVisibility, 1000);
            window.setTimeout(syncFallbackVisibility, 1500);
        } catch (error) {
            status.textContent = 'We could not update cookie preferences. Please try again.';

            if (window.console && typeof window.console.warn === 'function') {
                window.console.warn('Qualified consent fallback error:', error);
            }
        }
    }

    function watchDataLayerForConsentEvents() {
        window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];

        if (window.dataLayer.__imQualifiedConsentFallbackWrapped) {
            return;
        }

        var originalPush = window.dataLayer.push;

        window.dataLayer.push = function () {

            for (var i = 0; i < arguments.length; i++) {
                var item = arguments[i];

                }

                if (item.event === 'Functional_consent_granted') {
                    setFallbackVisible(false);
                    closeModal();
                }

                if (item.event === 'Functional_consent_denied') {
                    syncFallbackVisibility();
                }
            }

            return result;
        };

        window.dataLayer.__imQualifiedConsentFallbackWrapped = true;
    }

    acceptButton.addEventListener('click', acceptCookiesAndChat);
    closeButton.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    backdrop.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
        if (event.key === 'Escape' && !modal.hidden) {
            closeModal();
        }
    });

    // Initial check.
    syncFallbackVisibility();

    // Watch for GTM/Civic consent events after this footer code loads.
    watchDataLayerForConsentEvents();

<script>
(function () {
    'use strict';

    var COOKIE_CONTROL_COOKIE = 'CookieControl';

    // Current GTM/Civic optionalCookies order:
    // 0 = analytics
    // 1 = functional
    // 2 = targeting
    var ANALYTICS_CATEGORY_INDEX = 0;
    var FUNCTIONAL_CATEGORY_INDEX = 1;

    var root = document.getElementById('im-qualified-consent-fallback');
    var launcher = document.getElementById('im-qcf-launcher');
    var modal = document.getElementById('im-qcf-modal');
    var backdrop = document.getElementById('im-qcf-backdrop');
    var acceptButton = document.getElementById('im-qcf-accept');
    var closeButton = document.getElementById('im-qcf-close');
    var status = document.getElementById('im-qcf-status');

    if (!root || !launcher || !modal || !backdrop || !acceptButton || !closeButton) {
        return;
    }

    function getCookie(name) {
        var cookies = document.cookie ? document.cookie.split(';') : [];
        var prefix = name + '=';

        for (var i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
            var cookie = cookies[i].trim();

            if (cookie.indexOf(prefix) === 0) {
                return cookie.substring(prefix.length);
            }
        }

        return '';
    }

    function parseCookieControlCookie() {
        var raw = getCookie(COOKIE_CONTROL_COOKIE);

        if (!raw) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            return JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(raw));
        } catch (decodeError) {
            try {
                return JSON.parse(raw);
            } catch (parseError) {
                return null;
            }
        }
    }

    function isGrantedValue(value) {
        return (
            value === true ||
            value === 'accepted' ||
            value === 'granted' ||
            value === 'on'
        );
    }

    function hasFunctionalConsent() {
        var cookieState = parseCookieControlCookie();

        if (!cookieState || !cookieState.optionalCookies) {
            return false;
        }

        return isGrantedValue(cookieState.optionalCookies.functional);
    }

    function setFallbackVisible(isVisible) {
        root.hidden = !isVisible;
    }

    function syncFallbackVisibility() {
        setFallbackVisible(!hasFunctionalConsent());
    }

    function openModal() {
        modal.hidden = false;
        backdrop.hidden = false;
        status.textContent = '';
        acceptButton.focus();
    }

    function closeModal() {
        modal.hidden = true;
        backdrop.hidden = true;
        status.textContent = '';
        launcher.focus();
    }

    function acceptCookiesAndChat() {
        if (
            !window.CookieControl ||
            typeof window.CookieControl.changeCategory !== 'function'
        ) {
            status.textContent = 'Cookie preferences are still loading. Please try again in a moment.';
            return;
        }

        try {
            // Fire Civic callbacks for analytics and functional consent.
            window.CookieControl.changeCategory(ANALYTICS_CATEGORY_INDEX, true);
            window.CookieControl.changeCategory(FUNCTIONAL_CATEGORY_INDEX, true);

            closeModal();
            setFallbackVisible(false);

            // Re-check after Civic/GTM have had time to update the CookieControl cookie and dataLayer.
            window.setTimeout(syncFallbackVisibility, 250);
            window.setTimeout(syncFallbackVisibility, 1000);
            window.setTimeout(syncFallbackVisibility, 1500);
        } catch (error) {
            status.textContent = 'We could not update cookie preferences. Please try again.';

            if (window.console && typeof window.console.warn === 'function') {
                window.console.warn('Qualified consent fallback error:', error);
            }
        }
    }

    function watchDataLayerForConsentEvents() {
        window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];

        if (window.dataLayer.__imQualifiedConsentFallbackWrapped) {
            return;
        }

        var originalPush = window.dataLayer.push;

        window.dataLayer.push = function () {
            var result = originalPush.apply(window.dataLayer, arguments);

            for (var i = 0; i < arguments.length; i++) {
                var item = arguments[i];

                if (!item || !item.event) {
                    continue;
                }

                if (item.event === 'Functional_consent_granted') {
                    setFallbackVisible(false);
                    closeModal();
                }

                if (item.event === 'Functional_consent_denied') {
                    syncFallbackVisibility();
                }
            }

            return result;
        };

        window.dataLayer.__imQualifiedConsentFallbackWrapped = true;
    }

    launcher.addEventListener('click', openModal);
    acceptButton.addEventListener('click', acceptCookiesAndChat);
    closeButton.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    backdrop.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
        if (event.key === 'Escape' && !modal.hidden) {
            closeModal();
        }
    });

    // Initial check.
    syncFallbackVisibility();

    // Watch for GTM/Civic consent events after this footer code loads.
    watchDataLayerForConsentEvents();

    // Fallback checks for users changing preferences via the Civic panel.
    window.setInterval(syncFallbackVisibility, 2000);
})();
</script>
